Thirty-prompt fold batches, not full hidden-test batch size; clustering scale transfer unverified.
Quantized cached features; not bitwise reproduction of fp32 S02 extraction.
Only the weighted DeBERTa component is scored, not its marginal change to S02 ensemble accuracy.
Historical development reuse; conditional fixed-prediction bootstrap omits refitting/clustering variability; no official submission or paid service.
